The '''1946–47 Danish 1st Division''' season was a [[Association football|football]] annual competition in the [[Danish 1st Division]] in Denmark. It was contested by 10 teams.

[[Akademisk Boldklub]] successfully defended its [[1944-45 Danish War Tournament|1945 title]] defeating their opponent in the 1946 title final.

Statistics of [[Danish 1st Division]] in the 1946/1947 season.
